profileEvidence.summary: Alert and eager to work with its handler, the Koolie tends to put its herding instinct to practical use. It can gather sheep or cattle, move a group in a chosen direction, or hold stock together while waiting for instructions. Australian breeders have long selected for field performance, with somewhat different lines serving open paddocks, yards and livestock trucks.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An alert, handler-focused Australian herder whose instinct is to gather, move or hold livestock as a working team.
